description: Find licensed pest control companies near a US city. Returns up to 8 businesses that hold a state license record covering that city and pest type, each with its license number, published phone number, the official state source link, and the date PestPin last processed that source. Also returns a link to the full list, where a homeowner can call any company for free or send one request that is offered to a single company at a time and never resold. Listings are matched public records, not recommendations or a ranking, and most businesses have not confirmed services or coverage with PestPin.

city.description: City name, e.g. Houston. A city name only, never a street address.

pest.description: Optional pest type, e.g. termites, bed bugs, rodents, ants, cockroaches, mosquitoes, wildlife. Defaults to general pest control.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: find_licensed_pros

licenseNumber.description: License number on the state record

licenseState.description: Two-letter state that issued the license

name.description: Business name as the state record spells it

officialSourceAgency.description: Name of the state agency that publishes the record

phone.description: Published phone number, when the record has one

sourceCheckedOn.description: ISO date PestPin last processed the source behind this record

sourceCheckedOnScope.description: 'record' when the date is this record's own last check, 'state' when it is the last time PestPin processed that state's source

verifyAtOfficialSource.description: Official state regulator page where this record can be checked

fullListAndFreeRequest.description: PestPin page with the full list and the free request form

location.description: City and state the answer covers

note.description: The limits a reader must be told

totalRecordMatchedCompanies.description: How many license-record companies match, before the 8-row cap

title: Find licensed pest control companies
